projectDetail.helpMerge: Sandbox OS env merge order: platform < project < Agent < runtime; later wins on conflicts. Official ACP auth keys may be set in project env as a pipeline baseline; Agent same-name keys override. Agent Studio does not inherit project env; platform-level env never injects official auth keys.
projectDetail.helpNamespaces: Project sandbox env and project workflow variables (vars.*) are separate namespaces with no automatic bidirectional mapping; use {'${vars.x}'} in env values to bridge. Agent Studio interactive sandboxes do not inherit project env.
projectDetail.helpSecret: Secret keys are masked on read; leave empty or **** to keep the stored value. Un-secreting or renaming clears the mask so you can re-enter a value. Official ACP auth keys (e.g. CURSOR_API_KEY) in project env are always forced Secret and masked; they cannot be stored as plain text.

claude.step1: Open Anthropic Console → API Keys (or Claude Platform → Settings → Keys)

codebuddy.step1: Confirm the site selected in the Agent step (International / China / …)

trae.step1: In the Trae enterprise console: Profile → Access tokens → CLI login token
trae.step2: Generate a trae-lt-… token and copy it

git.meta: Choose GitHub / GitLab / SSH and optionally add recommended vars. Skip and finish later in Studio.

env.meta: Environment variables injected into the sandbox. Region keys are managed by the Agent step; secrets stay in the Agent config.

mcp.meta: Configure MCP servers. When skipped or the mcp list is empty, the server writes the default artifact-store.

rules.meta: Edit the alwaysApply identity rule. Skipping still writes the system default template.

prompts.meta: Override platform prompt fields. Skipping keeps platform defaults (no empty overwrite).

review.meta: Review the summary, then create once. Cancel/close does not persist. Configure MCP / Rules and other capabilities later in Studio.
